Implemented all five `devkit/` modules according to their docstrings:

- **`devkit/semver.py`** — SemVer parsing/validation, canonical formatting, precedence comparison, and `||` comparator-set range matching including `^`, `~`, and pre-release gating.
- **`devkit/cron.py`** — Five-field cron parsing with ranges, steps, month/weekday names, Vixie DOM/DOW OR semantics, and next-run search over the five-year horizon.
- **`devkit/duration.py`** — ISO 8601 duration parsing/formatting and calendar-aware addition with month-end clamping.
- **`devkit/table.py`** — Markdown table formatting with escaping, widths, and alignments, plus tolerant parsing back into header/rows/alignments.
- **`devkit/ini.py`** — Line-based INI parsing with sections, continuations, comments, case-insensitive keys, and recursive `${...}` / `$$` interpolation with cycle detection.

I also ran sanity checks covering round trips, edge cases, invalid inputs, SemVer precedence rules, cron results against a brute-force minute scanner, and INI interpolation/error handling. Temporary check files were removed.
